text:
maria: Quick sync — after the GPU surge postmortem we need concrete owners + dates for three areas: quota backstop, scheduler tuning, and a short-term headroom plan. I'll collate into the tracker.
jon: I can own quota backstop. What targets should I aim for and what's the deadline?
lee: I'll take scheduler tuning. Plan: change bin-packing heuristics + preemption rules, run A/B for 48h.
sam: I can do the headroom plan (30% reserve windows + ramp playbook). Will draft ops runbook.
maria: Thanks — targets: quota = +15% capacity across p3/p4 pools for 30 days, due EOD Thu; scheduler tuning experimental changes due next Mon; headroom plan due Friday. I'll add to tracker.
jon: OK I'll start with a quota policy PR today. Need to confirm which accounts get reserved buffer.
lee: For scheduler I'll prototype two changes: increase GPU packing weight, and reduce preemption aggressiveness. Will post perf numbers.
sam: Headroom runbook will include short-term burst quota, auto-bump policy, and communication playbook for CS.
ops-bot: Reminder: create JIRA epic + tickets for each action item and tag owners.
maria: Can we also set a recurring 2-week check-in cadence for 6 weeks so we catch regressions? Round-robin owners for each check-in.
jon: Fine by me. I'll own the first two-week window, then rotate to @lee/@sam.
lee: For the tests I need a small dedicated cluster slice (4 nodes) for A/B runs. @maria can you approve?
maria: Approved — I'll allocate from Dedicated pool for the 48h test. Keep changes behind a feature flag.
sam: Also proposing a capacity alert: `gpu_free < 20% for 10m` to give an earlier signal before user impact. I'll add it to the PR.
lee: Will instrument scheduler metrics (bin_util, preempt_count) and add to dashboard; need a short-lived query for the experiment.
jon: I'll include a short policy doc in the PR describing bump logic and rollback conditions.
maria: Assignments recap: quota -> jon; scheduler -> lee; headroom plan -> sam. @ops-bot create epic + tickets and set due dates (quota Thu, scheduler Mon, headroom Fri).
ops-bot: EPIC created: EPIC-4567. Tickets: TASK-789 (quota) assigned to jon, TASK-790 (scheduler) assigned to lee, TASK-791 (headroom) assigned to sam. Links: https://jira.redwood/browse/EPIC-4567
jon: Got it — will open PR and link TASK-789. :thumbsup: 
lee: Will open PR w/ perf run results and link TASK-790. Will need approval after runs.
sam: I'll add the headroom runbook and alerting rules to TASK-791.
maria: One more: add circuit-breaker fallback to route best-effort loads to spot pools during surges as a follow-on optional action.
jon: That sounds sensible — mark as follow-on in the epic.
ops-bot: Reminder created: 3 days before each ticket due date.
maria: Thanks all — I'll provide a short readout at next ops sync and update the postmortem with owners/times.
